name: Partial discharge sensor
summary: Sensor on switchgear, cables or transformers that picks up signals from partial discharge for insulation condition monitoring.
description: Partial discharge sensors detect small electrical discharges inside insulation before it fails. Common types include transient earth voltage sensors on metal-clad switchgear, UHF antennas in gas-insulated equipment and high-frequency CTs on cable earth straps, each feeding a monitoring unit that records and trends the activity.

The symbol shows the sensor location but not its type or frequency range, and results from different sensor types are not directly comparable. Monitoring is used for maintenance decisions rather than protection, so the sensor output normally goes to alarms or a condition monitoring system rather than a trip circuit.
readingNotes: Identify the sensor type at each location.
Confirm outputs go to monitoring rather than tripping.
distinction: A partial discharge sensor assesses insulation condition; an insulation monitoring relay measures insulation resistance of an unearthed system.
